name: 連絡先表示名と並び替え・更新条件の概要帯
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Salesforce Contacts list heading and status strip as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact source crop is 620 by 128 pixels, a wide shallow 4.84:1 composition. Preserve that ratio and use the full crop; no blank bands, surrounding page, right-side action toolbar, browser chrome, or card framing.

Match the source geometry and restrained Salesforce styling: soft cool-gray background, compact typography, clean alignment, no heavy shadows. At the far left show the same purple circular Contacts app icon with its white contact-card glyph. Near its right edge, place the small muted section label 「連絡先」 on the upper line. Below it, place a dark navy semibold heading 「最近表示した連絡先」 with a small downward caret at the same far-right position relative to the heading, followed by the outlined circular star/pin control in the same position as the source. Keep the icon group and all whitespace compact.

Near the bottom of the crop, preserve the single muted metadata line with the same bullet separators and spacing: 「4件 • 名前順 • 最近表示で絞り込み • 数秒前に更新」. Keep it on one line. The purple icon is the only strong color; the heading is dark navy, metadata and small label are quiet gray, and the star/caret use thin gray outlines.

Use the supplied reference as geometry, color, and state authority. Do not add the right-side primary action buttons, extra filters, card borders, row content, labels, or decorative elements.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves the title, metadata, icon group and state, but the output is 2170x725 (3:1) rather than the source 620x128 (4.84:1). The heading and pin control are also noticeably oversized relative to the crop; one bounded reframe attempt remains.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
